MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next addition because it would let me control a lamp through the Alexa devices I already own.",
    "The larger external drive fits my past use of a 4TB backup drive and offers a meaningful capacity increase, although I would still need to assess its reliability."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Older Echo displays, older Dots, and additional streaming sticks repeat functions covered by my recent Show 5, fourth-generation Dot, and Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle.",
    "The memory-card bundle includes a reader I do not currently need, while the internal SSD assumes an upgrade project and computer compatibility I have not established.",
    "The clock-equipped Dot and larger Show display interest me, but their added features are not enough to make me replace or supplement devices I recently bought."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be taken as a reason to recommend more Alexa speakers and displays, even when they duplicate what I already have.",
    "My history with storage and computer accessories seems to imply that any related upgrade would be useful, although external backup capacity, removable storage, and internal drives meet different needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent device purchases and the stand for my Show 5 suggest that I am using and completing my current setup, which makes immediate replacements less appealing.",
    "An accessory that adds a new function feels more timely than another device with the same purpose; an older backup drive leaves more room for a useful capacity upgrade.",
    "Frequent purchases do not mean I currently need every related accessory or have a computer that supports a particular internal component."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my Alexa and practical electronics interests but miss the difference between extending my setup and duplicating needs I recently filled."
}
